entries.title: Preserve verified corrections as the active baseline
entries.lesson: When a correction has been explicitly accepted and subsequently verified, treat the corrected behavior as the current baseline. Do not reintroduce the superseded behavior unless newer evidence or a higher-priority instruction requires it.
evidence: Repeated project iterations showed that a previously corrected implementation can regress when later work recreates an older assumption instead of preserving the verified baseline.

entries.title: Resolve repository paths from the actual working root
entries.lesson: Before changing or documenting repository paths, inspect the actual tree and resolve paths relative to the agent's current repository working root. Keep repository-internal setup paths distinct from generated target-project control-plane paths.
evidence: The internal ARAMF directory rename was initially described from the wrong path perspective; inspecting the repository root showed that ./ARAMF/ was the actual directory to rename while generated <ProjectPath>/ARAMF/ had to remain unchanged.

entries.title: Selected products define lifecycle preconditions
entries.lesson: Lifecycle preconditions must be derived from the explicitly selected product set. Optional products must not introduce mandatory lifecycle requirements when they were intentionally excluded.
evidence: TEST-198: Generate and Verify passed with Memory excluded; Finalize initially failed on unconditional memory validation.
TEST-204: Same selective-generation failure pattern; passed after the correction.
TEST-210: Same selective-generation failure pattern; passed after the correction.
Correction gated memory-related Finalize requirements on the selected Memory product; all three retests passed with no recurrence.
